description: Authoritatively cancel every open order on the page at the hosted layer — terminal, nothing to broadcast, no gas owed. Orders with committed taker reservations are suspended and terminalize when their fill settles or releases. Paged; requires wallet proof.

chainId.description: Optional chain filter. Required when the same market address exists on multiple chains.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

marketAddress.description: Optional market filter. Omit to cancel across all of the wallet's markets.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

walletAddress.description: Wallet address whose orders should be cancelled

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).

name: problee_cancel_all_orders
title: Authoritatively cancel all open orders at the hosted layer, optionally scoped to a market
